scope: Bounded independent read-only snapshot. This public run is terminal; the complete direct matrix and legitimate follow-up jobs are not necessarily terminal. Only persisted request observations are counted.

route_finding.actual_observation: Every persisted request has direct route/revision0, HTTPX transport, TLS certificate verification true, no CONNECT in either diagnostic field, and no CONNECT-label mismatch. Environment proxy presence is retained as diagnostic evidence; it does not change a frozen direct client.
route_finding.limits: Route is a model HTTPX configuration and CONNECT trace observation; it does not prove absence of OS/network intermediaries. Counts exclude requests still in flight without persisted usage/error events.

coverage_finding.classification: Same pre-existing conservative coverage policy as the environment public review, combined with the model-selected limited single-security scope. No wrong or unread claimed demand ID was found.
coverage_finding.evidence: Claimed ID [2058] is in frozen scope [2058] and read IDs [2058]; security-only scope lacks account/public/cash_only, so complete_task_demands rejects coverage of the universe_changed demand.
coverage_finding.test_boundary: test_limited_security_scope_cannot_complete_account_wide_demand and test_public_submission_requires_action_and_explicit_demand_coverage support conservative scope and completed-report/noncompleted-demand separation. No dedicated contract was found requiring a single-security public report to auto-complete universe_changed.
coverage_finding.snapshot_vs_live: Publication expected305/completed0/uncovered305 is immutable report metadata. Later relevance routing acknowledged304 public_information demands; universe_changed2058 remains uncovered. Current routes are302 awaiting_retry and2 routed. Awaiting_retry is unresolved material relevance, not302 model retries or evidence that302 originals were read.

source_isolation.boundary: Final report material_delivery_ids are receipt IDs, not material IDs. Claimed receipts are a subset of all public-task/child deliveries. Own-task child reports are allowed synthesis inputs and distinct from importing private account analyses. Public raw documents may have a source owner. Source-link receipts prove metadata delivery only. Evidence is stored receipts/identity and code path, not every outbound prompt or packet.
